name: H-E-B Houston RSC (Windfern Road) - Houston TX

fieldNotes.facility: Large H-E-B distribution + production campus on the Windfern Rd corridor, NW Houston. Multiple solar-roofed warehouse buildings (the RSC) plus production buildings with silos (bakery/dairy). Roster idx 8 and 9 (snack plant, milk/bread plant) are separate buildings in this same corridor.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is fully enclosed by a decorative metal perimeter fence with masonry columns (confirmed in Street View, 2026-01). Web source (hub.biz / chamber listing) explicitly states the facility 'accepts vendor deliveries through a security check-in process' — a controlled truck gate. truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Security check-in process implies a staffed gate. A modern office building anchors the SE corner near the main entrance. guardShack classified true on the strength of the documented security check-in; the booth itself was not isolated in imagery due to tree cover — medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple warehouse buildings with long dock-door banks and trailers backed in on several faces; total well into the 50+ band (estimated ~160).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very extensive trailer drop yards — large arrays of parked trailers (no tractors) on the north, central and south parts of the campus; estimated 280 visible, capacity ~400.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on distinct building faces across multiple buildings — separate shipping and receiving operations.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True multi-building campus: RSC distribution warehouses plus production buildings (silos visible) and an office building.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access roads run the length of the campus; deep stacking room between the gate and the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal roads and gate aprons — room for a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; campus bounded by a drainage channel and residential.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimate from perimeter box covering the fenced campus.
